restrictions: Classical probabilistic 256-bit word RAM, fresh independent uniform random-word primitive, total computation on one processor.
One batch of 2^128 iid uniform 64-byte messages from a 512-bit domain; repetitions retained; no restarts or advice.
Complete fixed-IV SHA3-256, rate1088, capacity512, suffix0x06, prefix rounds0..4, all256 digest bits; one padded absorption block per message.
Four independently sampled messages evaluated together by masked 256-bit word operations implementing four disjoint 64-bit Keccak lane fields; no cross-field rotation or addition.

Last-round early abort: the 256-bit digest is exactly output lanes 0..3, so the final round produces only those four lanes (theta in full; rho/chi only for the needed lanes), lowering the packed permutation from 5*341 to 4*341+123 = 1487 operations per four-message group. Adopts the packing and early-abort construction of public submission commit 83021803bc142633b6aed777e5b3fd5c0e30f91d (127.12, in review); replaces its four 64-bit radix passes with two fully charged 128-bit passes.

Stable two-pass 128-bit-digit radix sort of full digest/message records, with the complete 2^128-counter table initialized and charged on each pass, followed by a distinct-input full-digest scan and two charged target verifications.
Analytical upper bound with infeasible storage, no measured full-width collision, no PRNG, random-function, differential or round-independence heuristic.
All primitive construction, program/constant setup, memory initialization, lookup, sorting, randomness, failures and verification are charged at C=1355.

No H-RF / random-function heuristic (empty heuristics list). Success is a fixed-function birthday bound for iid uniform 64-byte messages on a 512-bit domain (proof Section 8). Addresses F-HRF-FIXED-TARGET-PROBABILITY.
